method: Read from source at the baseline revision (the working tree has no frontend changes against it). No builds, no tests. Verdicts are source-derived.

SCN-IDN-001.evidence: frontend/src/features/models/model/models-store.ts:26-52 keys every REST-hydrated Model as providerId/modelId, so 8,173 rows, one per provider and the slash id, hold at the baseline. Not trivially passing: the bare-id mutant (catalogModelId returns the bare model id) collapses 8,173 rows to about 3,830 and must FAIL the count; a mutant that passes makes the scenario BLOCKED.

SCN-IDN-002.evidence: The value assertions pass at the baseline because upsert is a shallow merge (frontend/node_modules/@prometheus-ags/entity-graph-core/dist/index.d.ts:358,401) so REST-hydrated flat fields survive a snapshot. The negative control fails: frontend/src/lib/realtime/uar-sse-adapter.ts:258-271 validates only the id, so a record without model_id is ingested and no ingestion error is shown. Whole-scenario verdict FAIL.

SCN-IDN-003.evidence: models-store.ts:26-52 issues one upsertEntity per row for about 8,170 models inside hydrateCatalog, and features/models/ui/models-page.tsx:326 mounts every filtered row. Source-derived; the runner measures the baseline and the row requires a long task above 200 ms in at least 3 of 5 samples, else BLOCKED.

SCN-IDN-004.evidence: Steps 1-3 pass (models-store.ts:98-140 saves through updateProvider), but the configured list is useModelsStore.configuredProviders loaded only by load() (models-store.ts:86-90, use-models-admin.ts:17-19) and nothing refreshes it on a provider change made elsewhere, so the second page fails the external-add step. Dropped-add and dropped-remove mutants must fail the store read-back.

SCN-IDN-007.evidence: features/models/ui/models-page.tsx:326 maps every filtered row into the DOM with no virtualization; with 8,173 models the page mounts more than 8,000 row elements against the cap of 200.
